subject.title: PR5/5 durable core: internal session delivery handoff

question: Should the opt-in durable runtime’s new shared SQLite model, public Gateway/protocol surface, environment enablement, and startup session-delivery handoff ship on the `release/2026.7.1` line?
rationale: The change establishes durable product, storage, API, and operator contracts rather than repairing an already-defined regression, so code review cannot determine release sponsorship or long-term ownership.

options.title: Approve and harden this release stack
options.body: Confirm the durable runtime contract, then require immutable CI tooling and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, restart, reset, and delivery proof before merge.

options.title: Retarget to main or a later release
options.body: Keep the implementation work but move it off the current release line so the data model and API can receive normal product and migration review.

options.title: Decline the durable-core direction
options.body: Close the cumulative stack and retain the existing session delivery queue without introducing the new durable runtime contract.

recommendation.title: Approve and harden this release stack
recommendation.body: Confirm the durable runtime contract, then require immutable CI tooling and exact-head fresh-install, upgrade, restart, reset, and delivery proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: They are the strongest available history-backed owner for the existing session-delivery queue semantics, though broader release sponsorship may require additional maintainers.
